cards.title: Full invariant finite-H ROC/QC projection with an exact finite range test
cards.scientific_scope: The full nine-dimensional real left-SO(2)-invariant homogeneous quartic space V on real 2x2 matrices, with H=((a-d)^2+(b+c)^2)^2 and the eight-dimensional quotient V/span{H}.
cards.statement: For every G in V, a finite real alpha with G+alpha H rank-one convex exists iff a finite real beta with G+beta H all-background quasiconvex exists. Alpha and beta may differ. QC quantifies every bounded planar Lipschitz domain, every affine B and every W0^(1,4) vector perturbation, with the periodic analogue. Finite membership is equivalently the exact block-range predicate: there exist five real Gram parameters with C_G(z) positive semidefinite and ker C_G(z) contained in ker B_G^T. The projected cone is nonclosed.
cards.reported_status: Root version-2 theorem is internally unconditional with separate equation-first contact and global analytic coverage audits. Generic constructor: 363 exact assertions; independent contact audit: 31 exact groups; global audit: 40 exact groups. These counts have separate finite scopes. source_derived_unreviewed.
cards.proof_availability_scope: Completed root version-2, constructor and independent receiving proofs are readable. Strict completion is classical/inherited; shear and parallel strata are pinned inherited premises; the generic oblique stratum is a new current internal derivation. Exact root preservation selection and live publication are later steps.
assumptions: Real homogeneous degree-four integrands; left SO(2) invariance only.
Completion is existence after deleting H; no equality at the same coefficient is assumed.
Compatibility and the stated zero-boundary or periodic W1,4 test class are retained.
Classical finite complex L4 Beurling estimate, plus the pinned exact shear/parallel completion results.
proof_spine: At I, D2H vanishes; a nonnegative conformal acoustic form is either strict on unit rank-one directions or has a nonzero contact.
Orthogonal conjugation preserving H and the full QC test maps every contact to trace-free shear, parallel e11 or finite nonzero oblique (t,1) tensor e1.
The oblique stationary span, forced support and explicit boundary gradients exhaust all weak coefficients; its strict support receives the pinned flat compiler.
Classical strict absorption and pinned exact shear/parallel theorems cover the other cases, giving one finite coefficient for every B/domain/test.
The exact acoustic lift and PSD block-range criterion decide finite ROC membership; the independently proved quotient equality transfers that membership conclusion to QC completion.
cards.costs: The supplied rational oblique-contact compiler uses fixed matrices of order at most four and fixed quartic expressions with polynomial bit work in the rational input length. The full block-range predicate can require exact algebraic scalar isolation/kernel computation; no tolerance-based PSD implementation or optimal fixed-alpha QC solver is supplied. Near t=1, ell=m=1, k=1/2+eta, every completion needs alpha >=1/(32 eta)+13/80+47 eta/200; a sufficient coefficient has the same inverse-eta order. Precision, conditioning and contact acquisition remain charged.
cards.information_acquisition: The theorem is mathematical for arbitrary real coefficients. Rational supplied-contact data are computational inputs; a general contact/strictness finder and acquisition of coefficients are separate. No missing ZIP or preliminary stronger paper is a proof premise.
cards.obstruction: The coefficient may need to change and diverges approaching excluded boundary classes. Acoustic SOS alone is an ROC certificate. It supplies no fixed-alpha QC assertion, planar Morrey resolution or physical operation.
cards.comparator: Iwaniec-Kristensen supplies classical strict homogeneous completion. The two-sided isotropic Bruno-Pasqualotto claim has stronger symmetry. Pedregal v5 claims broader 2x2 ROC/QC equivalence; the dedicated primary audit constructs exact compatible maps and a permitted mold whose set-valued image is empty for every input weight, refuting its stated universal-mold nonempty-image step. This source proof is not admitted as a premise; the counterexample does not decide the broader conjecture or every alternative mold.
cards.missing_lemma: No internal contact-coverage lemma remains missing in the independently audited existence theorem. External proof review, historical priority, least-alpha QC, and an implemented general exact admission service are separate outstanding obligations.
cards.next_decisive_step: Seek external mathematical review of the full completion theorem and scoped primary-proof counterexample, continue scope-matched priority comparison, and investigate fixed-alpha QC with its own exact all-gradient contract. Implement exact algebraic finite admission only with charged precision and correct QC coefficient scope.
cards.read_review_depth: Curation read the current entry/composition/continuity, scoped notices, generic necessity/sufficiency, orthogonal glue, independent derivation and full coverage audits, the block-range proof, and pinned shear/parallel/flat theorem ranges. It did not rerun inherited certificate arrays.
paragraphs: The incoming sharp-negative theorem substantially repeats pinned N867. Its missing certificate arrays may differ from those pinned earlier; claim overlap is not byte or coefficient identity. The new current advance is the full H-projection coverage and the finite range interface, with classical/inherited credit retained.

After one finite QC completion, an added reserve nu H gives the uniform numerical margin 4nu/1875 for every compatible test. This changes the integrand and supplies no global margin for an unchanged sharp J_r.

The primary-proof audit is a scoped inventory/correction, not a standalone major-theorem card. It uses l=1 periodic nodal arrays u=[[0,4],[2,3]], v=[[1,0],[0,2]] and a permitted paired-interface subtree. All proposed input/output fractions give U=(4,a), a in [-8,-4], and V=(8,b), b in [4,8], so det(U,V)>=48 and T(t) is empty for every t in Theta_1. Kakutani nonemptiness fails for that stated universal-mold construction; planar ROC=>QC remains undecided.

cards.title: Partial uniform margins for sharp negative quartics and the remaining concentration gate
cards.scientific_scope: For each fixed real r<-2, J_r=alpha H+beta u^2+j^2+r u j with alpha=3r/[8(r+2)] and beta=r(r-1)/6. Restricted compatible classes are distinguished from the open all-affine pure fourth-order bound.
cards.statement: On every rectangular torus, periodic W1,4 maps with phi2,x=0 satisfy Gap_B(phi)>=alpha/24 integral|Dphi|^4 for every affine B. On one fixed rectangular torus, or compact gradients supported in one fixed bounded subset of R2, normalized L4 gradients with uniformly integrable fourth-power densities satisfy liminf Gap_(t_n I)>=alpha when |t_n| tends to infinity. The latter uses the contact cubic estimate |ell(q)|<=C_r sqrt(m(q)) ||q||4 n(q). The full all-affine uniform gamma_r>0 remains unresolved. The independently audited fixed-profile full-affine slow-fast limit is at least alpha/3.
